text:
maria_sales: Hey team — AcmeCo (enterprise POC) is asking for a temporary QPS bump for a 2-hour demo tomorrow 09:00–11:00 PT. They want ~120 QPS sustained. They're currently on hosted default 10 QPS. Need scoped/ephemeral key + IP allowlist. Opp: ACME-232. Can infra/billing approve?

devon_se: 120 QPS for 2 hours — do we need dedicated pool or is hosted with a higher quota OK? Also what's the max burst and concurrency expectations from Acme?

maria_sales: They said mostly short chat completions, avg resp ~100 tokens, concurrency ~20. No heavy embedding traffic. Prefer hosted if we can hit SLOs and cost is reasonable.

priya_infra: Hosted is fine if we adjust rate limit and enable prefix caching. We can issue a scoped ephemeral API key with a rate_limit override for the window. Need: start/end time, CIDR for IP allowlist (they'll give static egress IPs), and billing sign-off for temporary overage.

ethan_sre: Also want to set fallback policy -> if capacity constrained, route to a cheaper model variant rather than erroring. Can we attach a routing policy to the scoped key?

priya_infra: yes — we can attach a policy that allows fallback to redwood-small when redwood-base can't meet latency. We'll set canary rollout to 100% for the window but with fallback.

maria_sales: CIDR is 34.201.22.0/24 (customer-provided). Start 2026-03-22T16:00Z end 2026-03-22T18:00Z (that's 09–11 PT).

alan_billing: For billing: temporary bump will be billed as usage, but we can apply promo credit for the POC. Need expected token estimate. At 120 QPS * 3600s * 2h * ~100 tokens = 120 * 7200 * 100 = ~86,400,000 tokens — rough calc. I'll provision a $1k credit unless finance requires more sign-off.

devon_se: For the admin flow, infra — what's the command to create the scoped key? Can you paste a sample?

priya_infra: Sample admin call (we'll run from infra console):
```POST /v1/admin/keys
{
  "owner": "sales:ACME-232",
  "scopes": ["completion:invoke"],
  "rate_limit": {"requests_per_second": 120, "burst": 240},
  "ip_allowlist": ["34.201.22.0/24"],
  "expires_at": "2026-03-22T18:30:00Z",
  "metadata": {"purpose": "POC-demo-AcmeCo"}
}
```
We'll tag it `poc/acme-232/ephemeral` and set audit logs.

ops-bot: Request POC-648 has been created and assigned to infra. ETA provisioning: ~40 minutes.

ethan_sre: Quick checklist for the demo: 1) scoped key + IP allowlist 2) fallback model policy 3) token limits and alerting 4) test traffic from their IPs 30m prior. I can run a smoke test from our staging region.

priya_infra: I'll provision the key and routing policy. Devon, can you share the endpoint they should hit and the header pattern (we'll rotate after expiry)?

devon_se: Endpoint: `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` Use header `Authorization: Bearer <P0C-ACME-TEMP>` We will redact token after demo.

alan_billing: I've applied a $1k promo credit to ACME-232 and flagged finance. If usage goes above estimate, we'll request a discretionary bump.

maria_sales: Perfect — I'll tell the customer 09–11 PT confirmed, we will send ephemeral key and test instructions 30m before start. Thanks! :thumbsup: 

priya_infra: Provisioned and pushed the key to secure vault. Token will be valid 16:00Z–18:30Z, rate-limited at 120 RPS with 240 burst. Routing policy attached. Audit id: audit-POC648.

devon_se: I'll run the smoke test at 15:30Z from the customer's egress IP. Please DM the key to the designated contact once test passes.

maria_sales: DM sent to acme-poc@acme.com with instructions.

ethan_sre: Smoke test passed (latency median 110ms, p95 340ms). No errors under 150 concurrent connections.

maria_sales: Customer confirmed demo success. Closing thread. :tada:
